tool_allowlist.evidence: tooling/render_omp.py rejects write, edit and bash on every entry; omp/catalog.yaml carries one explicit tools list per agent

subagent_dispatch.degraded_behavior: the task tool is projected only on the orchestrator and review-lead entries; every other entry is read-only and cannot dispatch

shell_tool.refusal: no entry may carry bash or write; a role whose canon assumes a shell gets an overlay that states the constraint instead of a widened tool list

mcp_resources.attempted: no MCP resource or tool is projected in omp/catalog.yaml; not exercised on 2026-10-31

host_inferred_spawn.refusal: activation is explicit; the task tool is omitted from leaf entries so the host cannot infer a spawn

web_search.evidence: omp/catalog.yaml projects web_search onto the researcher entry only; tooling/render_omp.py --check enforces the per-entry list

task.degraded_behavior: the task tool is projected onto the orchestrator and review-lead entries only; every other entry cannot dispatch

loop_gate.degraded_behavior: the runtime has no pre-dispatch hook: the orchestrator can pass a spec to a task child without a verdict check. The gate is carried by the project's CI step `python3 tooling/check_loop_gate.py` over the WL-08 ledger and the plan-review verdict records, and by `check_plan_spec.py` before a spec is dispatched

refusals: shell_tool: unsupported, no entry may require a shell
host_inferred_spawn: unsupported, leaves carry no task tool
notes: Admission covers the projected tool posture and the dispatch topology only. Prompt fidelity, cache behavior and model quality are not admission claims; they are measured separately (AS-08, MC-02). AD-12: loop_gate is degraded, not supported -- no runtime hook exists; the repo gate is the enforcement point.
